provenance: h17 SLURM; conda flits-a1-312 / flits-venv (dynesty 3.1.0); AUTO-TF S/N target 8 (DSA qualifies at target<=8, robust common window). Jobs: squarelaw+freealpha d331b5f4 (freealpha completed, squarelaw completed), plpbf 3668ba82. PPC a33cff34.
method: 2D joint CHIME+DSA nested-sampling (dynesty nlive=400), shared-zeta gain-marginal likelihood. Square-law=exp PBF alpha fixed 4 (beta=4 thin-screen limit). Free-alpha=exp PBF alpha in [4,6]. Power-law=inner-scale PL-PBF (run_joint_fit_plpbf.py), alpha tied to beta, log10_s_i in [-1,4].
data_axis: identical AUTO-TF axis for all 3 fits (CHIME 64ch x 6.2MHz f16/t16; DSA 12ch x 15.6MHz f512/t2; 17.8ms robust common window) -> ΔlnZ is valid.

free_alpha.beta_flag: RAILS to beta=3.99 (alpha=4 prior edge) -> data prefer the square-law limit even when alpha is free in [4,6]

power_law_pbf.beta_flag: RAILS to beta=4.0 with large inner scale s_i~25 tau_e -> even the power-law PBF collapses to the exponential/square-law limit when it fits the true burst

verdict.chi2_note: All 3 models fit equally well (CHIME 1.26, DSA 1.01); selection is by Bayesian evidence, which decisively favors square-law (ΔlnZ +2.9 vs free-α, +11.7 vs PL-PBF).
verdict.alpha_railed_note: Neither free-α nor PL-PBF produces a sub-4 alpha in the good mode; both rail to beta=4. Chromatica's scattering is consistent with a single thin screen (Kolmogorov-like alpha=4), NOT a shallow (alpha<4) spectrum.
verdict.reconciliation_with_ondisk: The on-disk canonical _a1_fits product reports alpha=3.28 (sub-4). Our fresh good-mode fits show alpha=4 is decisively preferred; the plpbf fit CAN reach beta=3.43 ONLY in the earlier degenerate/fixed-res prep (v1), and in the good mode (v2) it rails to beta=4. The sub-4 alpha therefore appears to be an artifact of the prior prep path / over-wide crop, not a property of the burst. The good-mode tau_1ghz (0.126 ms) is also shorter than the on-disk 0.196 ms.
verdict.gate: PASS (good mode: chi2~1, non-degenerate parameters matching canonical structure zeta~0.19/x_zeta~-1.49/delta_dm_D~0.27). Prior MARGINAL gate traced to DSA marginal S/N (just under target 10); honest re-run at target 8 recovers a clean fit.

caveat: DSA S/N is genuinely marginal (qualifies only at S/N target<=8, not the default 10). Results are robust at target 7-8 but the burst sits near the joint-fit publication threshold; this is a real (not fatal) quality caveat carried from the prior MARGINAL flag.
